message: Could you make sure every studio page shows its accessibility notes alongside the session times?
When a member makes a valid cancellation, please put the place back into availability and email them to confirm the cancellation.
On busy days, can we let helpers manage bookings so the coordinators are not doing everything themselves?
Can you make the availability update instantly whenever somebody books or cancels?
We would also like native iPhone and Android apps so members can make their bookings from either phone platform.
If a session is full, could a member ask to receive an email when a place becomes available?
For full sessions, could members join a queue where the person who joined first is the first person notified when space opens?
Please make ceramic-kiln reservations confirm automatically like the other studios instead of sending them to a coordinator.
Can we revisit the calendar sync and have confirmed StudioLane reservations appear in members' external calendars?
When somebody cancels a full session, can StudioLane give that place automatically to the next member in the queue and email them the confirmation?
